# Hospitals

This folder catalogs the individual hospitals, specialized departments, and ambulatory clinics across Denmark that participate in the DANIBD national quality database for inflammatory bowel disease. The pages detail each facility's performance against specific clinical quality indicators—such as DEXA scanning rates, fecal calprotectin monitoring, and postoperative colonoscopies—and include internal audit findings, operational feedback, and areas where diagnostic or treatment targets were missed or exceeded.

## Pages

- [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] — A major university hospital that conducted internal audits questioning the validity of Indicator 1 and fell below the 70% target for adult diagnostic compliance.
- [[abdominalcenter-k-bispebjerg-hospital|"Abdominalcenter K, Bispebjerg Hospital"]] — A specialized abdominal center that performed audits and corrected data for re-operation metrics.
- [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] — A regional facility in the Capital Region distinguished for having the highest number of registered patients receiving biological medical systemic treatments.
- [[egs-esbjerg-medicinsk-mave-og-tarm-amb|Esbjerg Medicinsk Mave og Tarm Amb.]] — An ambulatory clinic that achieved the highest department-level compliance for DEXA scans during steroid courses.
- [[herlev-mave-tarm-leversygd|"Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."]] — A gastroenterology and hepatology department evaluated for its mixed compliance rates in DEXA scanning and fecal calprotectin measurements.
- [[hvidovre-gastroenheden|Hvidovre Gastroenheden]] — A gastroenterology unit demonstrating a sharp disparity in clinical practice, with low DEXA scan compliance but exceptional adherence to fecal calprotectin testing.
- [[hvidovre|Hvidovre]] — A major university department handling both adult diagnostics and highly specialized pediatric VEO-IBD cases, noted for missing the Indicator 1a target.
- [[nordsjaelland-kirurgisk-overafdeling|Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling]] — A surgical department tracked for its low target fulfillment on DEXA scanning but high compliance with calprotectin measurements.
- [[nordsjaellands-hospital|Nordsjællands Hospital]] — A Capital Region hospital notable for its high adoption of the Constant-Care app and local NPU coding for point-of-care calprotectin measurements.
- [[ouh-odense-kirurgisk-afdeling-a|OUH Odense Kirurgisk Afdeling A]] — A surgical department that implemented targeted operational initiatives focusing on steroid tapering and acute patient management following internal audits.
- [[ouh-odense-medicinsk-mave-tarm-afd-s|OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S]] — A medical department recognized as the only facility with over 10 patients to achieve the development target for postoperative colonoscopies in Crohn's disease.
- [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]] — A healthcare facility identified as one of four departments failing to meet the diagnostic examination requirements for newly diagnosed adult IBD patients.
- [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — A regional hospital that audited re-operation rates, arguing that anastomotic leakage is a more relevant surgical quality metric, while also missing the Indicator 1a target.
- [[rigshospitalet-med-klinik-mave-tarm-lever|"Rigshospitalet Med. Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."]] — One of Denmark's largest gastroenterological departments, tracked for its low fulfillment rates in DEXA scanning and calprotectin testing despite large patient volumes.
- [[sjellands-universitetshospital|Sjællands Universitetshospital]] — A university hospital in Region Sjælland listed in technical appendices for its clinical use of biological treatments and surgical procedures.
- [[slb-kolding-boerne-og-ungeafdeling|SLB Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling]] — A pediatric and youth department evaluated for its performance on Indicator 2 regarding patient education.
- [[slb-vejle-gastroenterologisk-amb|SLB Vejle Gastroenterologisk Amb.]] — A gastroenterology clinic recognized as a positive outlier for achieving a 27% fulfillment rate in patient education, significantly above the national average.
- [[slb-vejle-medicinsk-afdeling|SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling]] — A medical department evaluated across multiple years for its performance on DEXA scanning, calprotectin testing, and re-operation metrics.
